verses.sanskrit:
शल्य उवाच।
              अथैनां रूपिणी साध्वीमुपातिष्ठदुपश्रुतिः। तां वयोरूपसंपन्नां दृष्ट्वा देवीमुपस्थिताम् ॥१॥
verses.english: Shalya said Then did beautiful Upashruti appear before the chaste one. Ard seeing the goddess possessed of youth and beauty appear before her.
verses.bhavadeepa: यत्रेति । अयं चार्थः ‘आ नो या ह्युपश्रुत्युक्थेषु रणया इह ॥ दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो’ इति मन्त्रोक्त उपबृंहितः । मन्त्रार्थस्तु - हे उपश्रुति नः अस्मान् प्रति आयाहि उक्थेषु काम्येषु कर्मसु इह रणय इष्टं कामं गमय प्रापय ॥ रण गतावितस्य रूपम् । अमुष्य बुद्धिस्थस्य दिवं शासत इन्द्रस्य दिवं प्रकाशं यय गमय यच्छेत्यर्थः । व्यय गतावित्यस्य लोटि रूपम् । वलोप आर्षः । हे दिवावसो अह्नो धनं सूर्यस्तद्वत् तमोग्रस्तमर्थं प्रकाशयितुं समर्थः ॥२७॥

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्राणी संप्रहृष्टात्मा संपूज्यैनामथाब्रवीत्। इच्छामि त्वामहं ज्ञातुं का त्वं ब्रूहि वरानने ॥२॥
verses.english: The Queen of Indra became well-pleased and having propitiated her, thus spoke-O you of a beautiful face, 'I want to know you, tell me who you are.'

verses.sanskrit: उपश्रुतिरुवाच। उपश्रुतिरहं देवि तवान्तिकमुपागता। दर्शनं चैव संप्राप्ता तव सत्येन भाविनि ॥३॥
verses.english: Upashruti said I am, O goddess, Upashruti, who have come to you. O you of noble mind, I have appeared in your sight through your truthfulness.

verses.sanskrit: पतिव्रता च युक्ता च यमेन नियमेन च। दर्शयिष्यामि ते शक्रं देवं वृत्रनिषूदनम् ॥४॥
verses.english: You are chest, you observe all the rules of life and you possess the power self control. I shall show you the god Shakra the slayer of Vritra.

verses.sanskrit: क्षिप्रमन्वेहि भद्रं ते द्रक्ष्यसे सुरसत्तमम्। ततस्तां प्रस्थितां देवीमिन्द्राणी सा समन्वगात्॥५॥
verses.english: I wish you well, follow me soon, you shall see the best among the gods. Then did the goddess the queen of Indra, follow her w went in advance.

verses.sanskrit: देवारण्यान्यतिक्रम्य पर्वतांश्च बहूंस्ततः। हिमवन्तमतिक्रम्य उत्तरं पार्श्वमागमत्॥६॥
verses.english: Having gone through many forests of the gods and many mountains and having crossed the Himavat, the northern side was reached by them.

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रं च समासाद्य बहुयोजनविस्तृतम्। आससाद महाद्वीपं नानाद्रुमलतावृतम् ॥७॥
verses.english: And having crossed the sea which extended over many yojanas they came to a large island which was covered by many trees and creepers.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापश्यत् सरो दिव्यं नानाशकुनिभिर्वृतम्। शतयोजनविस्तीर्णं तावदेवायतं शुभम् ॥८॥
verses.english: They there saw a lake, suitable for the gods frequented by many birds and which extended over a hundred yojanas in length and a similar space in breadth.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र दिव्यानि पद्मानि पञ्चवर्णानि भारत। षट्पदैरुपगीतानि प्रफुल्लानि सहस्रशः॥९॥
verses.english: And saw there, O son of Bharata thousands of beautiful lotuses of five colours full blown and around which the bees hummed.

verses.sanskrit: सरसस्तस्य मध्ये तु पद्मिनी महती शुभा। गौरेणोन्नतनालेन पद्मेन महता वृता ॥१०॥
verses.english: Having penetrated into a particular lotus and entered into stalk, along with her (Sachi) they there saw the performer of a hundred sacrifices who had entered the stalk.

verses.sanskrit: पद्मस्य भित्त्वा नालं च विवेश सहिता तया। बिसतन्तुप्रविष्टं च तत्रापश्यच्छतक्रतुम् ॥११॥
verses.english: Seeing her lord staying there in a diminutive form, the goddess too assumed a diminutive form and so did Upashruti.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा च सुसूक्ष्मेण रूपेणावस्थितं प्रभुम्। सूक्ष्मरूपधरा देवी बभूवोपश्रुतिश्च सा॥१२॥
verses.english: Beholding there Indra in a form of very minute, goddesses Upashruti and Indrani also became in the form of minuteness.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रं तुष्टाव चेन्द्राणी विश्रुतैः पूर्वकर्मभिः। स्तूयमानस्ततो देवः शचीमाह पुरन्दरः ॥१३॥
verses.english: And the queen of Indra propitiated Indra by reciting the deeds done by him in olden days and the god Purandara, being thus propitiated, said to Sachi.

verses.sanskrit: किमर्थमसि संप्राप्ता विज्ञातश्च कथं त्वहम्। ततः सा कथयामास नहुषस्य विचेष्टितम् ॥१४॥
verses.english: With what object have you come here and by what means came you to know that I was here. Then did she narrate the attempt of Nahusha.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रत्वं त्रिषु लोकेषु प्राप्य वीर्यसमन्वितः। दर्पाविष्टश्च दुष्टात्मा मामुवाच शतक्रतो ॥१५॥
verses.english: Having obtained the lordship of the three worlds and so being vain of his strength and being haughty the evil minded one asked me to attend on him, Operformer of a hundred sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit: उपतिष्ठेति स क्रूरः कालं च कृतवान्मम। यदि न त्रास्यसि विभो करिष्यति स मां वशे ॥१६॥
verses.english: And the evil minded one has granied me time (to do his bidding). If you do not save me, O lord, he will bring me under his sway.

verses.sanskrit: एतेन चाहं संप्राप्ता द्रुतं शक्र तवान्तिकम्। जहि रौद्रं महाबाहो नहुषं पापनिश्चयम् ॥१७॥
verses.english: For this reason have I come to you so soon O Shakra, O you with long arms slay Nahusha of wicked purposes.

verses.sanskrit: प्रकाशयात्मनाऽत्मानं दैत्यदानवसूदन। तेजः समाप्नुहि विभो देवराज्यं प्रशाधि च ॥१८॥
verses.english: O you slayer of Daityas and Danavas, hide no longer your ownself. O lord, assume your own strength and rule the kingdom of the gods.
